bundle.shortDescription: Animated AI desktop pet for Windows
bundle.longDescription: Nook AI Pet is a local-first animated 3D desktop companion for Windows with four pets, autonomous behavior, Ollama local/cloud AI, notes, todos, persistent timers/reminders, restricted file search, app launching, secure credential storage, crash recovery and release-update support.
